title: 第28章 小刘：外人竟是我自己
content_zh:
“你先坐一会，我去做饭。”

    “刘姐，我帮你。”

    “不用不用，你先去歇着，一会就好了。”

    刘小丽把谷川推了出来，还不满的对刘艺菲说道：“有客人来了，还不快点去倒点茶水。”

    “哦哦。”刘艺菲在一脸的懵逼中点头。

    “不用了。”

    “客气什么，就像是来了自己家一样。”

    刘艺菲浑浑噩噩的给谷川倒了水，又看了一眼回到厨房忙碌的妈妈。

    再看看谷川，坐姿端正却不显僵硬，眉眼温润，双手老老实实地搭在膝盖上，嘴角噙着一抹温良无害的笑，一看就是个好孩子。

    “你怎么和我妈这么熟的？”刘艺菲压低了声音问道。

    “不是你给我的联系方式吗？聊着聊着就熟了。”谷川说道。

    那也不能这么熟啊！

    这才多长时间啊！

    刘艺菲小声问道：“说，你到底有何居心？我告诉你，不要以为你和我妈混熟了，就可以不用还钱。”

    “我眼界没那么小。”

    “嗯？”刘艺菲瞪大了眼睛。

    6315美元的眼界还小吗？

    刘艺菲问道：“你不会要朝我妈借钱吧？！”

    “钱钱钱，你满脑子都是钱，你也就这点出息了。”

    谷川语气很失望，但嘴角挂着的温和笑意一点都没变，还时不时的看向厨房的位置，让刘艺菲想要打死他。

    谷川说道：“我不是美国国籍嘛。”

    “然后呢？”

    “然后没办法在国内搞电影公司啊，只能搞中外合资的。”

    “所以你想找我妈当合伙人？”刘艺菲问道。

    当初刘艺菲母女一起去的美国，为了小刘的学习和生活方便，给她换了美国国籍，但刘小丽没有。

    “聪明。”谷川满意的点头。

    “那不可能。”刘艺菲语气坚决。

    和谷川一起搞合资公司，会被谷川给坑死的。

    刘艺菲眯着眼睛问道：“中外合资，法人好像只能是中方的吧？”

    “很聪明。”

    “那就更不可能了。”刘艺菲说道。

    “你说了又不算，我都被邀请来你们家里了，你说你妈有没有这个打算。”

    “你！！”
content_en:
"You sit down for a while and I'll cook."

    "Sister Liu, let me help you."

    "No, no, you go and have a rest first. You'll be fine in a while."

    Liu Xiaoli pushed Gu Chuan out and said to Liu Yifei dissatisfied: "A guest is here, why don't you hurry up and pour some tea."

    "Oh." Liu Yifei nodded with a confused look on her face.

    "No need."

    "You're welcome, it's like coming to your own home."

    Liu Yifei poured water for Tanichuan in a daze, and then glanced at her mother who was back in the kitchen busy.

    Look at Tanichuan again, he is sitting upright but not stiff, his eyebrows are gentle, his hands are resting on his knees honestly, and there is a gentle and harmless smile at the corner of his mouth. He looks like a good boy at first glance.

    "How come you are so familiar with my mother?" Liu Yifei asked in a lowered voice.

    "Isn't it the contact information you gave me? We became familiar with it as we chatted." Tanichuan said.

    Then you can't be so familiar!

    How long does it take!

    Liu Yifei asked in a low voice: "Tell me, what are your intentions? I tell you, don't think that because you are familiar with my mother, you don't have to pay back the money."

    "My horizons are not that small."

    "Huh?" Liu Yifei's eyes widened.

    Is $6,315 still a small horizon?

    Liu Yifei asked: "You don't want to borrow money from my mother, do you?"

    "Money, money, money, all you can think about is money, and that's all you've got."

    Tanichuan sounded disappointed, but the gentle smile hanging on his lips did not change at all, and he looked at the kitchen from time to time, making Liu Yifei want to beat him to death.

    Tanigawa said: "I am not an American citizen."

    "Then what?"

    "Then there is no way to set up a film company in the country, so we can only set up a Sino-foreign joint venture."

    "So you want to find my mother as a partner?" Liu Yifei asked.

    When Liu Yifei's mother and daughter went to the United States together, for the convenience of Xiao Liu's study and life, she was granted American citizenship, but Liu Xiaoli did not.

    "Smart." Tanichuan nodded with satisfaction.

    "That's impossible." Liu Yifei said firmly.

    If you start a joint venture with Tanigawa, you will be tricked by Tanigawa.

    Liu Yifei squinted her eyes and asked: "For a Sino-foreign joint venture, it seems that the legal person can only be Chinese, right?"

    "Very smart."

    "That's even more impossible." Liu Yifei said.

    "It doesn't matter what you said. I've been invited to your home. Do you think your mother has this plan?"

    "You!!"
title_en: Chapter 28 Xiao Liu: The outsider is actually myself
